SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores, count(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(closing_units) AS units
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-30' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.close_date, count(*) AS n, sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, min(fs.closing_units) AS minu, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.units_sold_4w, ROUND(s.units_sold_4w/4.0,1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900),
dups AS (SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl FROM f),
ctl AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) AS ctl_units FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND store_id < 900),
mine AS (SELECT sum(quantity) AS all_units, sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS test_units, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS s999, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days, min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1 FROM f)
SELECT * FROM dups, ctl, mine
